t: “Salaries and expenses”, $16,416,000, of which $5,389,000 shall be derived by transfer from Federal Prison System, “Buildings and facilities”;

fable.w: This is a pure appropriations line that funds salaries and expenses and transfers money between federal accounts. There is no tempting participation reading: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue. The only actors are federal accounts and entities, so no party outside the federal government is involved in any decision.
fable.s: of which $5,389,000 shall be derived by transfer from Federal Prison System

opus.w: This section only sets an appropriation amount and moves funds between two federal accounts. The transfer from the Federal Prison System's 'Buildings and facilities' account stays entirely inside the federal government. It involves no outside party and no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking or right to sue, so it is not participation.
opus.s: “Salaries and expenses”, $16,416,000, of which $5,389,000 shall be derived by transfer from Federal Prison System, “Buildings and facilities”;
opus.b: 1. **Analysis.** Someone might read "derived by transfer from Federal Prison System" as two bodies coordinating. That reading fails because the transfer moves money between accounts of the same federal agency. No one outside the federal government takes part, and there is no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking or right to sue.

qwen_chat.w: This section is an appropriations provision that specifies budget amounts and the internal transfer of funds between federal entities (Federal Prison System). It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government, such as the public, states, tribes, or private organizations. Intra-governmental financial transfers do not constitute participation under the provided definition.
qwen_chat.s: “Salaries and expenses”, $16,416,000, of which $5,389,000 shall be derived by transfer from Federal Prison System, “Buildings and facilities”;
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that transferring funds from the Federal Prison System to another account involves coordination between federal entities, which could be misconstrued as "participation." However, the definition explicitly states that consultation or coordination *between* federal agencies or officials is "intra-government coordination" and is not participation. Furthermore, this text is purely an appropriations clause specifying budget amounts and sources, with no mention of any external parties, public comment, hearings, or advisory boards involving non-federal entities.
